envelope.reason: restated at the conceptual altitude: the earlier wording carried harness mechanism, which made every finding about the mechanism look like a flaw in the concept
envelope.cause: regrounding with the operator, 2026-09-29: shards state what and why, never how; the design is the fixed goal

payload.gloss: a guard binds exactly the agents whose composition includes it, on every supported harness, and judges every turn it fires on. Where a harness cannot tell which agent is running, the guard is carried as a stated rule instead and the operator is told; a guard that fires and judges nothing never ships.
